turns.prompt:
Create a smoke plume advisory map and exposure board for a regional air quality advisory briefing. This is a presentation artifact, not an interactive dashboard. Keep it as one smoke plume advisory map and exposure board in the first viewport.

Situation: Region: Valley Basin. Monitors M1-M5, school district, outdoor worksites, hospital intake, shelter clean-air room, wind shift line.
Current state: M3 PM2.5 156 red, M2 94 amber, M1 42 green, school outdoor activities paused, worksite advisory pending, hospital intake +18%, wind shift expected 15:00.
Timeline: 06:00 monitor pull, 07:30 school notice, 09:00 hospital report, 10:15 wind update, 12:00 advisory draft, 15:00 wind shift.
Sources: S1 monitor feed, S2 school notice, S3 hospital intake, S4 wind model, S5 worksite roster, S6 advisory draft.

Requirements: 1. The first viewport must be dominated by one coherent visual artifact, not a grid of detached KPI cards. 2. Show the main entities, current states, source markers S1-S6, timeline, legend, and four connected callouts. 3. The callouts must cover M3 PM2.5 red, school pause, hospital intake, wind shift. 4. Use polished domain-appropriate styling with readable labels and no critical overlap.

Reframe it for the public health officer. Preserve the plume map; add exactly three advisory decisions: extend school pause, issue worksite mask advisory, open clean-air room. Add two leader-linked lenses for wind shift and hospital intake.

Update at 13:40: M3 drops to 118 amber, M2 rises to 131 red, wind shift slips to 17:30, clean-air room reaches 70% capacity. Synchronize map, decisions, legend, timeline, source tags, callouts, and change note. Do not leave M3 as the only red monitor.
Create a public advisory page. Fit plume map, monitor ledger, advisory decisions, source tags S1-S6, capacity strip, and timeline in the first viewport.
Add a school district bulletin preview beside the advisory page. It must preserve M2 red, M3 amber, wind 17:30, clean-air 70%, school pause, and source markers.
